text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Mayano. Are you perhaps
waiting for
someone?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fuji! You gotta hear this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So you had movie plans with Akebono,
but she was forced to cancel due to a
sudden errand...
Does that mean you'll
go alone?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No way... I wanted to watch it together
with her.
Besides, I already missed the
screening...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't look so glum. If you're not
against the
idea, how about I join you
today?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? You'll play with me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Why, I'll take you on an
exciting day
filled with whimsy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All right! Okay, sooo today, I wanna...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whooa! Look at those gloves, Fuji! They
look so
grown-up! I want them, I want
them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They do look lovely... But I believe I can
warm up
your hands just fine myself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that childish of me to grow
jealous over a
pair of gloves? Hehe, just
kidding.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa whoa whoa! Hold it! This must be
one of
those romantic grown-up dates!
Fuji's amazing...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I do enjoy looking at the sea, but
nothing
compares to seeing your face
gaze down at the
ocean creatures.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm so weak, aren't I? How the
solemn look
in your eyes steals away my
heart. I have to be
careful.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
From now on, when I look at the sunset,
I daresay
your image will come to mind.
For instance, the
touch of your hair...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! I can't, I can't! I can't breathe!
I'm not
ready to be a grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, have you had your fill? Hehe,
perhaps I
should act more
down-to-earth!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maya, I'm sorry for showing up late! And
thanks
for the tickets, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh... Huh?! Bono?! But how? What happened to your errand? And what tickets?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I called her earlier, and coincidentally,
her
sudden plans were just about done. I
also booked
you two some movie seats.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But when?! How were you able to do it right under my nose? What did you do?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this was no trick nor illusion!
When it comes to seeing the smiles of
my darling ponies, I
can pull off any
miracle! ♪
